/scripts.value:
on TakeSnapshot
	local tStack
	local tWidth,tHeight
	
	if exists(stack "Appli") = true then
		put "Appli" into tStack
	else
		put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	end if
	
	put the width of group "center" of stack tStack into tWidth
	put the height of group "center" of stack tStack into tHeight
	
	put round(tHeight * 1.00) into tHeight
	put round(tWidth * 1.00) into tWidth
	
	
	export snapshot from group "center" of stack tStack at size tWidth,tHeight to screenSnapshot as PNG
	
end TakeSnapshot
